intent: Climb from farmland through stronger wind, ride the windmill lifts, enter its machinery and emerge onto the exposed ridge. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The lower farmland
sections.lesson: Jump the farm walls beneath the sails. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The lower farmland
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The windy hillside
sections.lesson: Climb against the growing wind. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The windmill exterior
sections.lesson: Ride the counterweight up to the mill. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: Within the mill machinery
sections.lesson: Drop through the mill’s service rooms. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The ridge beyond the sails
sections.lesson: Brake before the last exposed ledges. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.
